correctness.rationale: Enomoto gives an exact minimal sequence \(0\to U_{q\lambda}\to P_2\to P_1\to U_\lambda\to0\) with explicit maps and \(\Omega^2(U_\lambda)\cong U_{q\lambda}\). Splicing produces an alternating resolution. Applying Hom into \(U_\mu\) gives one-dimensional terms with successive differentials \(\mu-q^r\lambda\) and \(0\); the zero maps follow because all length-two paths act trivially on \(U_\mu\). Cohomology yields the formula in every degree. Finite-order exact period follows from the same syzygy formula, distinct-parameter Hom vanishing, and the odd-syzygy dimension \(10\).

value.rationale: The computation gives the complete pairwise Ext support for the explicit module family that witnesses failure of the periodicity conjecture. For infinite-order \(q\), it shows that a nonprojective nonperiodic complexity-one module can have total self-Ext dimension only \(2\); for finite-order \(q\), it determines the exact period and every nonzero self-Ext degree. These are natural homological invariants of the counterexample, not arbitrary parameter slices or finite experiments.
